# Profile

Applied economist positioned at the intersection of development economics, entrepreneurship, data analysis and management studies. My research mobilises mixed methods (econometrics, qualitative work, primary data) to analyse the interplay between information technologies, energy, finance and well-being in emerging economies. Sustained scientific output of 18 articles in peer-reviewed journals (8 CNU B, 6 CNU C · 3 -- ABS 1, 2 ABS 2, 1 ABS 3), Franco-Cameroonian institutional anchoring (Sorbonne Paris Nord, CEPN, CEREG) and regular editorial activity for 12 international peer-reviewed journals.

# Teaching

More than **400 hours of teaching (TD equivalent)** delivered since 2021, to a variety of audiences (Licence, BUT, Bachelor in finance) in France and Cameroon. Active pedagogy grounded in case studies, mentoring of entrepreneurial projects and supervision of SAE final-year defences. Current courses are aligned with business school standards: entrepreneurship, management, change management, business plan, financial markets.
